Name: Title Screen Fairies (Content Patcher) - Fairy replacement for birds
Author: DegenerateFreak
Description:
This mod replaces the birds on the title screen with fairies.
The fairies are the sprites from the trinkets introduced in version 1.6, and the colour of fairy is randomised so they can be different every time you start the game (however, the 2 fairies will have the same colour as each other). 

It only replaces the title screen birds, so it will only be incompatible with other mods that replace or remove these birds (or if it replaces the entire TitleButtons file). 

Requires Content Patcher to work.
Tested in Stardew Valley version 1.6 only. 
To install the mod, download and unzip the file, then put the folder[i] [CP] Title Screen Fairies[/i] into your Mods folder. To uninstall it, remove the folder.

Feel free to edit the mod however you like, I don't claim any ownership since the sprites belong to ConcernedApe.
